schedule_task.title: Look again in half an hour [wizloop:once-in]
schedule_task.prompt:
[wizloop:once-in] A scheduled run of the loop file adapters/fixtures/t3/once-in.md. Do these steps in order. TIME below means the time now in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

1. Do this:
Look at the build again and say whether it passed.

2. Last, append `TIME once-in ok WHAT` to .openwiz/home/once-in/ok.log, where WHAT is one line saying what you did; or, if step 1 failed, `TIME once-in failed WHY`.
